gloss: to drink up; to drain; to finish a drink

definitions.gloss: to drink up; to drain; to finish a drink
definitions.explanation: To drink a beverage completely, emptying the container without leaving any liquid behind.

examples.japanese: ビールを{一気|いっき}に{飲|の}み{干|ほ}した。
examples.english: I drained the beer in one gulp.

examples.japanese: {冷|つめ}たい{水|みず}をコップ{一杯|いっぱい}{飲|の}み{干|ほ}した。
examples.english: I drank up a whole glass of cold water.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{残|のこ}っていたワインを{最後|さいご}の{一滴|いってき}まで{飲|の}み{干|ほ}してからグラスを{置|お}いた。
examples.english: He drained the remaining wine to the last drop before setting down his glass.

notes:
A compound verb formed from {飲|の}む (to drink) + {干|ほ}す (to dry out). The {干|ほ}す component adds the meaning of completely finishing or emptying a container of liquid.

USAGE:
- Emphasizes drinking everything without leaving any behind
- Often used with {一気|いっき}に (in one go) for dramatic effect
- Can imply a bold or determined manner of drinking

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ビールを{飲|の}み{干|ほ}す: to drain a beer
- {一気|いっき}に{飲|の}み{干|ほ}す: to chug; to drain in one gulp
- {最後|さいご}の{一滴|いってき}まで{飲|の}み{干|ほ}す: to drink to the last drop
- グラスを{飲|の}み{干|ほ}す: to empty a glass

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲|の}む: the basic verb for drinking; does not imply finishing
- {飲|の}み{切|き}る: to drink completely; similar meaning but less vivid
- がぶ{飲|の}みする: to gulp down; emphasizes the rough manner of drinking rather than completeness
